headline: Novartis Raises Full-Year Profit Guidance After Strong Q3 Sales
summary: Swiss drugmaker Novartis raised its full-year earnings outlook following stronger-than-expected revenue growth in the third quarter.
why: Novartis is a major global pharmaceutical manufacturer whose financial results reflect worldwide health spending and prescription drug demand.

impacts.name: Novartis AG
impacts.why: Strong Q3 earnings allowed management to lift full-year profit projections.

why_moved: Third-quarter sales growth exceeded forecasts and prompted an upward revision to full-year guidance.
